# CA-chain fixtures (T766, SEC-T756-02)

Inputs of `scripts/check-ca-chains.sh`, used by the `ca-chain-check-python` and `ca-chain-check-node` CI jobs and by `tests/functional/test_ca_chain_check.py`.

**Every certificate file here is a public X.509 certificate in PEM form, and `disclosure-spki.txt` lists public-key hashes. None is a private key, and none is a secret.** Each file was searched for `PRIVATE KEY` before it was written, and the test fails if one ever contains it. The extensions `.chain`, `.cert` and `.certs` are used instead of `.pem` because `.gitignore` and the repository's secret-file name rules treat `*.pem` as possible key material.

| Path | What | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `compromised/*.chain` (16 files) | The 16 PEM chains of the CVE-2026-115557 disclosure, leaf first, byte for byte. Name: `<directory in the zip>--<file stem>` without the `-emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com` suffix. | `chains.zip` from `https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/`, fetched 2026-11-07, sha256 `afb9d69e8e5fc9eb0c08d5fe4baafc67edbcced2d63af2f9deb62edb6431d4a9` (the same archive as T765, `docs/artifacts/ca-check-t765-v1.md`). The 3 readmes of the zip are not vendored; `proof.zip` was not downloaded. |
| `extra/*.cert` (3 files) | Certificates on the disclosure's keys that crt.sh holds and the disclosure's JSON does not list (T767, `docs/artifacts/ca-check-t767-v1.md` § 3): `crtsh-14658191778` (`emSign Root TLS CA - G3` cross-signed by `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`, sha256 `3094025792039A68…6EBBDD`), `crtsh-14658191774` (`emSign Root CS CA - G3` cross-signed by the same root, sha256 `7137FA71AD46BA68…DEBB59`), `crtsh-30002976010` (a second, validly signed `EM DV TLS CA - G3B` with the TBS of the listed one and another signature, sha256 `37E866582D43C35D…8AEFA8`). Each validates against `disclosure-roots.certs`. | `https://crt.sh/?d=<id>`, fetched 2026-11-07 by T766 (not copied from T767's scratch data); each fingerprint matched T767's. |
| `disclosure-roots.certs` | The 4 roots of the disclosure's `roots.json` (`emSign Root TLS CA - G3`, `emSign Root CS CA - G3`, `AAA Certificate Services`, `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`), in that order. Each certificate's sha256 matched the `sha256` field of `roots.json`. | `roots.json` from the same site, fetched 2026-11-07, sha256 `119f32cd81a6b5a4e3c4c2df5fe07daa90dc43cafa123a62f0394f1895d92380`. |
| `disclosure-spki.txt` | The SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the 12 distinct keys in `roots.json` and `impacted-intermediates.json`, one `<hex> <name>` per line. The check fails if any store certificate carries one, whatever its own hash. | The `spki_sha256` fields of both files; `impacted-intermediates.json` fetched 2026-11-07, sha256 `f67b3abe9b4879f4e91874ed041beccd71257f1db41c588c724ccf12aa90c59e`. The script's method (`openssl x509 -pubkey`, `openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER`, `openssl dgst -sha256`) reproduces the `spki_sha256` of `emSign Root TLS CA - G3`. |
| `control/gitlab.com.chain` | The chain `gitlab.com:443` served on 2026-11-07: `CN=gitlab.com` (not after 2027-05-12), `Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA DV R36`, and `Sectigo Public Server Authentication Root R46` cross-signed by `USERTrust RSA Certification Authority`. | `openssl s_client -connect gitlab.com:443 -servername gitlab.com -showcerts`, 2026-11-07. |

`SHA256SUMS` pins every file (`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` from this directory); the test checks it.

The check verifies at a fixed time, 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z, at which every certificate here is valid (latest not-before 2026-10-27, earliest not-after 2027-05-03), so the result does not change as the certificates expire. The fixtures need no refresh unless the disclosure adds chains or keys; the control may be replaced by any chain that validates against the CI images' stores at a time inside every fixture's validity, with `VERIFY_AT` in the script moved accordingly.
